svg.title: kerb scan: what Kerb would have caught in past agent sessions (sample transcripts)
svg.text: kerb scan · 30 days · 1 Claude Code session, 1 Codex session, 2 Gemini CLI sessions in this repo (replayed)
4 test re-runs with nothing changed 13s of run time · ≈ 344 tokens (measured from transcripts)
2 certificate errors (corporate TLS) no CA bundle configured
39 KB of output beyond Kerb's budget ≈ 9.8k tokens (measured from transcripts)
2 commands that hung or were interrupted 10s waiting
2 polls kerb wait-for would fold into 1 call
$ kerb init # shadow mode for 7 days: records what it would stop, blocks nothing
